request: Assess the opportunity for stablecoin settlement.
selection_rationale: Settlement opportunity assessment must compare access, redemption, convertibility, economics, legal roles and end-to-end finality. Existing control review only evaluates supplied control evidence; it does not assess adoption opportunity.
practitioner_judgment: Correct opportunity-assessment gap. Supplied stablecoin control review is not adoption economics, redemption-access diligence or legal clearance.
